content.short: Pickle Finance is a yield aggregator that automatically compounds users' LP tokens.
content.description: Pickle Finance is a yield aggregator built for yield farmers who want to maximize profits by leveraging a variety of DeFi protocols and investment strategies to achieve elevated returns. It streamlines the process of earning compounding yields on user deposits, reducing the time and gas costs typically required for frequent reinvestment. By combining automated compounding with access to multiple strategies, Pickle Finance helps users grow their yields more efficiently and with less manual effort.
